slices.focus: A quiet holiday trip to Osaka yields a handful of early-2000s acoustic songs that become Ayaka's end-of-shift spreadsheet cleanup ritual.
slices.summary: Ayaka visits her sister Eri in Osaka after the storm stretch eases. While sorting winter clothes, Eri's old playlist introduces four or five early-2000s acoustic songs that Ayaka becomes attached to. She starts playing them during end-of-shift spreadsheet cleanup, finding they soften the transition from work mode. She keeps them mostly confined to that task to preserve their calming association.
open_loops: Playlist effect may fade if overused outside the cleanup context
One-off visit may not sustain the restored connection with sister
